name: Zoom AMS-24
note: A USB audio interface (2 in, 4 out). Set as an extra input (EXTRA_INPUTS), its two inputs are recorded after the Sidekick's, on the Sidekick's clock, and nothing plays out of it; otherwise the rig draws it by its MIDI port. IN 1 is its first capture channel, checked with a guitar on 2026-11-03.

ports.label: IN 1
ports.about: XLR/TRS combo jack: mic, line or guitar. +48 V phantom power.

ports.label: IN 2
ports.about: XLR/TRS combo jack: mic, line or guitar. +48 V phantom power.

ports.label: OUT L
ports.about: Output A, balanced 6.35 mm TRS, left.

ports.label: OUT R
ports.about: Output A, balanced 6.35 mm TRS, right.

ports.label: USB-C
ports.about: USB Audio Class 2.0: 2 in, 4 out, up to 96 kHz at 24-bit. Bus-powered.

taps.about: IN 1, mono: the AMS-24's first capture channel.
IN 2, mono: the AMS-24's second capture channel.

hardware.extending: A second USB audio interface beside the Sidekick: a pair of mic, line or guitar inputs, recorded as extra inputs (EXTRA_INPUTS) on the main interface's clock, never played out of. Everything under "hardware" is ignored by the Go loader: it is notes for people.

connection.note: Plugged into the jam-space Pi on its own USB controller, beside the EP-136 (2026-11-02).

audio.inputs: Two XLR/TRS combo jacks; gain -inf to +58 dB, or -inf to +50 dB set to GUITAR; +48 V phantom power.
audio.outputs: OUTPUT A on two balanced 6.35 mm TRS jacks (+10 dBu max); headphone outputs A and B on 3.5 mm stereo jacks (30 mW + 30 mW into 32 ohm).
audio.usb_audio: USB Audio Class 2.0, 2 recording channels (S32_LE, 24 bits used, channel map FL FR) at 44.1, 48, 88.2 and 96 kHz; 4 playback channels (altset 1) or 2 (altset 2), never opened by Hindsight. Read off the Pi, 2026-11-02.
audio.switches: MUSIC/STREAMING (inputs independent, or summed into one signal), LOOPBACK (mixes the computer's playback into what it records), DIRECT MONITOR.
audio.$comment: Which playback pair feeds Output A and which feeds headphones B is not stated by Zoom's page; read it off the unit before adding returns.

midi.ports: Shows one MIDI port on the Pi, 'AMS-24 ZOOM AMS-24 Reserved Por': a reserved port, no musical MIDI.
midi.$comment: This port is what puts the AMS-24 in the rig's MIDI list.

controls.$comment: Gain knobs per input, the MUSIC/STREAMING, LOOPBACK and DIRECT MONITOR switches, and output levels are what Zoom's page implies. Read the layout off the unit before drawing a labelled diagram.

quirks.text: LOOPBACK on mixes the computer's playback into what it records. Hindsight never plays to it, so it would add nothing, but leave it off.
STREAMING mode sums both inputs into one signal; MUSIC mode keeps them apart, which is what separate taps need.
Shows a MIDI port on the Pi although Zoom's page lists no MIDI.

unknowns.question: Does the Pi's USB power budget hold with phantom power on?
unknowns.how: dmesg | grep -iE 'under-voltage|usb' after a few minutes of capture with +48 V on (a guitar doesn't need it).

hindsight.role: An extra input beside the EP-136: its IN 1 and IN 2 are the bus's channels 9 and 10, the sources ams1 and ams2.
notes: The EP-136 stays the main interface: the tape plays out of it and its clock is the ring's. The AMS-24's frames are resampled onto that clock by an adaptive ratio, written a little behind the head.
Hear the guitar with DIRECT MONITOR on, OUTPUT A into the Sidekick's AUX (it then lands on channels 7-8 too), or on the AMS-24's phones. The Pi never monitors.
